title: The Triangle of Everything: space
blurb: A map of every single thing, sorted by mass and size; the dance of the forces up the diagonal, from chemical bonds to the neutron star and the black hole; the black-hole line, the smallest black holes and dark matter; out to the largest structures, the cosmic event horizon and the furthest light we can see (the second take, 2026-11-18).
_note: The second take (the author, 2026-11-18: "that should cover all of space dance and the short"): rec75 as long-02b-opening, from the map of every single thing to the lucky few survivors, the forces Short's own opening left out (its 'intro' clips, after 'What is it?'); then rec76 as long-02b-right, from the nebulae to the furthest light. Replaces long-02-space when the author is happy with it. The first take's cut (rec74 and the Shorts already cut) is in git history.
_music: One piece after another under the whole video, no changes at the joins (the author, 2026-11-17: 'the long videos should not have music cuts'): Immersed, Mesmerize, Fresh Air, then Dreamer to the credits.
